items.about: NAVAL AIR STATION SIGONELLA, Italy (Dec. 8, 2025) Mrs. Latasha Vernon, Author of Jubilee's Surprise, held a book reading at Giuseppe Mazzini State Middle School in the town of Adrano, Dec. 8. NAS Sigonella's strategic location enables U.S., allied, and partner nation forces to deploy and respond as required to ensure security and stability in Europe, Africa, and Central Command. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Cryton Vandiesal)

items.title: Tim Hofman in Nijmegen voor dichtbundel
items.creator: N1
items.about: NIJMEGEN – Het was een enorme drukte afgelopen weekend in boekhandel Dekker van de Vegt door de komst van presentator Tim Hofman. Hij was in de winkel aan de Marikenstraat voor de signering van zijn nieuwe boek: Tim Hofman, gedichten van de broer van Roos.

items.title: Vermin Supreme Crashes HillaryTour Concord 15-24
items.creator: FreeConcordRaw
items.about: Tuesday December 05 2017 Gibson's Books - Concord, New Hampshire Hillary Clinton tours with her 'What Happened' book. A $30 event sold out downtown, as the line stretched around the corner. Vermin Supreme protests the appearance by his former primary rival, initially filing a lawsuit against the city of Concord for denying his right to have a pony present at the protest, saying, 'The pony is my speech'. The lawsuit was withdrawn when the city compromised, offering a 'free speech zone', and the allowance of the pony. Vermin led a mixed crowd of fellow travelers, including Berners, socialists, libertarians, and anarchists. Chalking festivities, musical interludes, and artistic readings followed, prompting one attendee to exclaim, "I'm offended!" Captured using a Nikon Coolpix P520 by Garret Ean All media creative commons, copying is not theft and sharing is caring
